title: 新加坡裕廊岩洞
summary: JTC公開介紹裕廊岩洞可儲存147萬立方公尺液態碳氫產品，並將地下深度與海床下深度分開；2014年開幕有總理公署紀錄。本課從土地介面、岩體節理與支護開始，進入水力封存、產品庫存及監測交付。幾何面積、局部壓差和假想庫存都不等於實際土地效益或操作上限。
summaryEn: JTC describes 1.47 million cubic metres of liquid-hydrocarbon storage and distinguishes depth below ground from depth beneath the seabed; the PMO records the 2014 opening. The course moves from land interfaces and jointed rock to support, hydraulic containment, inventory and monitoring. Geometric area, local pressure difference and hypothetical inventory are not actual land savings or operating limits.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下儲存與地面介面」與「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Subsurface storage and surface interfaces" and "Cavern wedges and anchorage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地下儲存與地面介面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Subsurface storage and surface interfaces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「幾何等效面積」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Geometric equivalent area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 裕廊以地下儲存重新配置地面用途，教材容積除高度只算假想幾何面積，不重述為實際節省土地。地下儲存可以重新分配地面用途，但洞室幾何投影不等於實際釋出的土地。出入口、消防、產品管線、地面製程與維修空間仍占用土地；將容量換算成等效面積只是一個比較基準，須保持高度、利用率和附屬設施範圍一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「幾何等效面積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Jurong reallocates surface use through underground storage; volume divided by height gives a hypothetical geometric area, not actual land released. Underground storage changes how surface land is used, but cavern projection is not the actual land released. Access, firefighting, product pipelines, surface processing and maintenance still require space. Converting volume to an equivalent area provides a comparison metric only when height, utilisation and auxiliary-facility boundaries remain consistent. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Geometric equivalent area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：儲存容積=100000 m³；等效高度=20 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: storage volume=100000 m³; equivalent height=20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「幾何等效面積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Geometric equivalent area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地下儲存與地面介面
knowledge.text: 裕廊以地下儲存重新配置地面用途，教材容積除高度只算假想幾何面積，不重述為實際節省土地。地下儲存可以重新分配地面用途，但洞室幾何投影不等於實際釋出的土地。
knowledge.textEn: Jurong reallocates surface use through underground storage; volume divided by height gives a hypothetical geometric area, not actual land released. Underground storage changes how surface land is used, but cavern projection is not the actual land released.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「新加坡裕廊岩洞」的「地下儲存與地面介面：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「隧道模型掘進交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Subsurface storage and surface interfaces: mechanism and system paths” in “Jurong Rock Caverns”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Tunnel model drive handover” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「地下儲存與地面介面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Subsurface storage and surface interfaces" is correct?
options: 地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。
裕廊以地下儲存重新配置地面用途，教材容積除高度只算假想幾何面積，不重述為實際節省土地。
錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。
optionsEn: Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved.
Jurong reallocates surface use through underground storage; volume divided by height gives a hypothetical geometric area, not actual land released.
Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls.
quiz.explanation: 裕廊以地下儲存重新配置地面用途，教材容積除高度只算假想幾何面積，不重述為實際節省土地。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Jurong reallocates surface use through underground storage; volume divided by height gives a hypothetical geometric area, not actual land released. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地下儲存與地面介面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Subsurface storage and surface interfaces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「幾何等效面積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Geometric equivalent area” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：儲存容積=100000 m³；等效高度=20 m。A=V/H=5000 m²。僅把等效高度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為4545.45 m²。邊界：假想等斷面平面面積，不是實際節省的地面土地；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: storage volume=100000 m³; equivalent height=20 m. A=V/H=5000 m². Increasing only equivalent height by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 4545.45 m². Boundary: Hypothetical uniform-section plan area, not actual surface land saving. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：儲存容積=100000 m³；等效高度=20 m。A=V/H=5000 m²。僅把等效高度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為4545.45 m²。邊界：假想等斷面平面面積，不是實際節省的地面土地；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: storage volume=100000 m³; equivalent height=20 m. A=V/H=5000 m². Increasing only equivalent height by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 4545.45 m². Boundary: Hypothetical uniform-section plan area, not actual surface land saving. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地下儲存與地面介面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Subsurface storage and surface interfaces", which statement holds?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。
原創教學假設：儲存容積=100000 m³；等效高度=20 m。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment.
Original teaching assumptions: storage volume=100000 m³; equivalent height=20 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：儲存容積=100000 m³；等效高度=20 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: storage volume=100000 m³; equivalent height=20 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地下儲存與地面介面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Subsurface storage and surface interfaces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「幾何等效面積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Geometric equivalent area” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。把洞室、豎井與地面設施分層繪圖，核對容積與占地邊界，分別列幾何面積和實際可使用土地。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing. Map caverns, shafts and surface facilities separately, reconcile volume and footprint boundaries and distinguish geometric area from usable land. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「幾何等效面積」的交付需回答：總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。比較方案時固定功能與配套範圍，將幾何指標標為假設，土地效益由完整總配置與營運需求判讀。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the geometric equivalent area handover must address the following evidence: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing. Fix function and auxiliary scope when comparing options, label geometric metrics as assumptions and assess land benefit from the full layout and operational requirements.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只算洞室投影會漏掉支援營運必需的地面設施。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。把洞室、豎井與地面設施分層繪圖，核對容積與占地邊界，分別列幾何面積和實際可使用土地。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing. Map caverns, shafts and surface facilities separately, reconcile volume and footprint boundaries and distinguish geometric area from usable land. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「幾何等效面積」的交付需回答：總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。比較方案時固定功能與配套範圍，將幾何指標標為假設，土地效益由完整總配置與營運需求判讀。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the geometric equivalent area handover must address the following evidence: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing. Fix function and auxiliary scope when comparing options, label geometric metrics as assumptions and assess land benefit from the full layout and operational requirements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地下儲存與地面介面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Subsurface storage and surface interfaces"?
options: 總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地下儲存與地面介面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Subsurface storage and surface interfaces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「幾何等效面積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Geometric equivalent area” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只算洞室投影會漏掉支援營運必需的地面設施。只用容積除高度宣稱節省土地會漏掉必要配套，可能低估地面通道、維修和消防的空間需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation. Claiming land saving from volume divided by height omits essential facilities and understates access, maintenance and firefighting space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：出入口、消防、產品管線、地面製程與維修空間仍占用土地；將容量換算成等效面積只是一個比較基準，須保持高度、利用率和附屬設施範圍一致。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Converting volume to an equivalent area provides a comparison metric only when height, utilisation and auxiliary-facility boundaries remain consistent.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只算洞室投影會漏掉支援營運必需的地面設施。只用容積除高度宣稱節省土地會漏掉必要配套，可能低估地面通道、維修和消防的空間需求。
knowledge.textEn: Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation. Claiming land saving from volume divided by height omits essential facilities and understates access, maintenance and firefighting space.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地下儲存與地面介面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Subsurface storage and surface interfaces" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只算洞室投影會漏掉支援營運必需的地面設施。
錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation.
Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls.
quiz.explanation: 只算洞室投影會漏掉支援營運必需的地面設施。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 岩洞節理楔體與錨固：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cavern wedges and anchorage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「楔體重力分擔」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wedge self-weight sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 裕廊大跨洞室的局部楔體由節理交線控制，教材自重均分不代表所有錨桿實際同時受力。大跨岩洞的局部穩定常由節理交線形成的可動楔體控制，完整岩石強度高仍可能產生重力掉塊。均分重量只估計錨固受力量級，滑移方向、節理水壓、錨桿角度與黏結長度須另驗，不能假設所有構件同時等量受力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「楔體重力分擔」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint intersections control local wedges in wide caverns; equal weight sharing does not imply simultaneous equal anchor loading. Local stability of a wide cavern can be governed by removable wedges formed by joint intersections even when intact rock is strong. Equal weight sharing estimates anchorage force scale only. Sliding direction, joint pressure, anchor inclination and bond length require separate checks, and simultaneous equal mobilisation of every anchor cannot be assumed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wedge self-weight sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「楔體重力分擔」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wedge self-weight sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 岩洞節理楔體與錨固
knowledge.text: 裕廊大跨洞室的局部楔體由節理交線控制，教材自重均分不代表所有錨桿實際同時受力。大跨岩洞的局部穩定常由節理交線形成的可動楔體控制，完整岩石強度高仍可能產生重力掉塊。
knowledge.textEn: Joint intersections control local wedges in wide caverns; equal weight sharing does not imply simultaneous equal anchor loading. Local stability of a wide cavern can be governed by removable wedges formed by joint intersections even when intact rock is strong.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cavern wedges and anchorage" is correct?
options: 錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
裕廊大跨洞室的局部楔體由節理交線控制，教材自重均分不代表所有錨桿實際同時受力。
optionsEn: Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Joint intersections control local wedges in wide caverns; equal weight sharing does not imply simultaneous equal anchor loading.
quiz.explanation: 裕廊大跨洞室的局部楔體由節理交線控制，教材自重均分不代表所有錨桿實際同時受力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint intersections control local wedges in wide caverns; equal weight sharing does not imply simultaneous equal anchor loading. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 岩洞節理楔體與錨固：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cavern wedges and anchorage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「楔體重力分擔」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wedge self-weight sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor。僅把岩塊體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為171.6 kN/anchor。邊界：僅自重均分量級，未含節理滑移、錨角及設計係數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count. T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor. Increasing only block volume by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 171.6 kN/anchor. Boundary: Equal self-weight sharing only, excluding sliding, anchor angle and design factors. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor。僅把岩塊體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為171.6 kN/anchor。邊界：僅自重均分量級，未含節理滑移、錨角及設計係數；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count. T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor. Increasing only block volume by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 171.6 kN/anchor. Boundary: Equal self-weight sharing only, excluding sliding, anchor angle and design factors. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cavern wedges and anchorage", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 岩洞節理楔體與錨固：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cavern wedges and anchorage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「楔體重力分擔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wedge self-weight sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。由掌子面和洞頂節理測繪重建三維塊體，配合錨桿試驗與伸長量檢查受力方向和有效錨固區。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Reconstruct three-dimensional blocks from face and roof mapping, combining anchor tests and extension measurements to check force direction and effective bonded zones. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「楔體重力分擔」的交付需回答：以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。錨固圖與三維節理模型連結，標示試驗代表性及未知延伸，幾何改變後由岩力設計者重驗失穩模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the wedge self-weight sharing handover must address the following evidence: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Link anchorage drawings to the three-dimensional joint model, state test representativeness and uncertain persistence, and reassess mechanisms when geometry changes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。由掌子面和洞頂節理測繪重建三維塊體，配合錨桿試驗與伸長量檢查受力方向和有效錨固區。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Reconstruct three-dimensional blocks from face and roof mapping, combining anchor tests and extension measurements to check force direction and effective bonded zones. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「楔體重力分擔」的交付需回答：以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。錨固圖與三維節理模型連結，標示試驗代表性及未知延伸，幾何改變後由岩力設計者重驗失穩模式。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the wedge self-weight sharing handover must address the following evidence: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Link anchorage drawings to the three-dimensional joint model, state test representativeness and uncertain persistence, and reassess mechanisms when geometry changes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cavern wedges and anchorage"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
quiz.explanation: 以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 岩洞節理楔體與錨固：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cavern wedges and anchorage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「楔體重力分擔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wedge self-weight sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。節理延伸到錨固端後方可能使錨桿連同塊體移動，材料拉力試驗合格也不能證明岩體黏結可靠。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint. A joint behind the bonded zone can let anchor and block move together; passing steel tension tests does not prove reliable rock bond. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：均分重量只估計錨固受力量級，滑移方向、節理水壓、錨桿角度與黏結長度須另驗，不能假設所有構件同時等量受力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sliding direction, joint pressure, anchor inclination and bond length require separate checks, and simultaneous equal mobilisation of every anchor cannot be assumed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。節理延伸到錨固端後方可能使錨桿連同塊體移動，材料拉力試驗合格也不能證明岩體黏結可靠。
knowledge.textEn: An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint. A joint behind the bonded zone can let anchor and block move together; passing steel tension tests does not prove reliable rock bond.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cavern wedges and anchorage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint.
quiz.explanation: 錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
